newsitem.title: USA: PanAmSat makes New Zealand Web connection.
newsitem.headline: PanAmSat makes New Zealand Web connection.

text.p: GREENWICH, Conn. , March 31 - PanAmSat Corp said Monday it has recently added New Zealand to the list of more than 20 countries that access the U.S. Internet backbone using its global satellite system.
Internet Group, an Auckland-based international Internet service provider, has turned to PanAmSat and the PAS-2 Pacific Ocean Region satellite to connect its users to the Internet.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
PanAmSat is actively marketing its new satellite-based Internet service, SPOTbytesSM, to international Internet service providers worldwide.
